name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A free, battle-tested cheat sheet that teaches your AI coding assistant to work like a careful senior engineer instead of a sloppy intern.
buyer: An engineering manager at a startup who's watched AI coding tools produce bloated, buggy code and wants a disciplined process installed on every developer's machine.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools consultancy bundles these skills into a paid 'AI engineering onboarding' workshop for teams newly adopting Claude Code or Cursor.
A boutique dev shop adapts and sells a private, stricter version of these skills tailored to one client's stack, as a retainer add-on.
The author monetizes indirectly: the repo itself is a funnel into a paid newsletter and course on working with AI coding tools.

money_ideas.idea: Private, client-specific skill packs sold alongside development retainers.
Paid workshop or course teaching teams how to adopt and extend a skills-based AI workflow.

steal_this: Fork it into a niche-specific pack (e.g. 'skills for regulated fintech codebases') and sell it as a one-time $99 download to teams in that niche this weekend.
